name: Opaque
description: Sanitises everything on your own machine - typed text, files, and the screen - before any of it reaches a reasoning model.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http:; connect-src 'self' data: blob: https: http://127.0.0.1:11434 http://localhost:11434
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' blob: 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src blob:; connect-src https://huggingface.co https://*.hf.co data: blob:; img-src data: blob:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
